text_block_list.text:
With a win at the Japanese Derby,
Symboli
Rudolf carves her name next to
the greatest
Umamusume in history.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She resolves to claim another crown in
the Kikuka
Sho, but her packed
schedule is starting to take
its toll, and
Эйр Грув is only getting more

concerned.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As usual, however, it's Симболи Рудольф's
way or
the highway. Even a grueling race
can't keep her
from her student council
duties.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
